def factor_overnight_intraday_dissonance_smoothed(df):
    """Smoothed signed square-root difference between overnight and intraday returns using registered decomposition."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight, intraday = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    overnight = overnight.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    intraday = intraday.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    signed_sqrt_overnight = np.sign(overnight) * np.sqrt(np.abs(overnight))
    signed_sqrt_intraday = np.sign(intraday) * np.sqrt(np.abs(intraday))
    raw_dissonance = signed_sqrt_overnight - signed_sqrt_intraday
    factor = raw_dissonance.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_dissonance_smoothed"] = factor.fillna(0.0)
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_dissonance_smoothed"]
description: Preserves the parent's overnight-intraday dissonance mechanism, which captures disagreement between overnight/global information and intraday/local trading. The parent's single-day signed square-root difference is noisy, weakening IC and rank stability. This mutation applies a 5-day trailing mean to the raw dissonance, smoothing transient gaps while retaining the core signed-square-root economic signal. The rolling window uses only past observations, and the factor remains continuous and interpretable without any cross-sectional transformation.
